title: Tomate Sauce
description: One of the five classic French mother sauces, prepared with tomatoes, mirepoix, herbs, and stock, creating a rich and versatile base for pasta, meat, poultry, seafood, and vegetable dishes.

ingredients.title: For the Tomate Sauce
items: 2 tbsp olive oil or pork fat
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste

instructions.title: Instruction
steps: Heat the olive oil or pork fat in a heavy saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion, carrot, and celery, then sauté until softened and aromatic.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for about 1 minute.
Add the peeled tomatoes and tomato paste, then cook for several minutes until slightly thickened.
Pour in the stock or water, then add the bay leaf, thyme, and pork rind if using.
Bring the sauce to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for 45–60 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the bay leaf, thyme, and pork rind.
Blend or pass the sauce through a fine sieve for a smooth consistency if desired.
Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper before serving.

chefTips: Slow simmering develops a richer, sweeter tomato flavor.
Use ripe tomatoes or premium canned tomatoes for the best results.
Blend and strain for a classic French-style smooth finish.
Tomate Sauce is the base for Marinara, Spanish Sauce, and Bolognese.
Excellent with pasta, poultry, seafood, meat, eggs, and vegetables.
